news.title: Man driven to hospital after shooting in SW Atlanta
news.summary: Atlanta police said a man was driven to the hospital after a shooting in southwest Atlanta on Saturday.

news.title: 1 injured after shooting in Forest Park, police say
news.summary: A 26-year-old man was injured after a shooting in Forest Park on Saturday afternoon, according to the Clayton County Police Department.

news.title: Mother charged in Gwinnett hot car death allowed to visit mortuary, grieve 1-year-old son
news.summary: A Gwinnett County mother charged in the hot car death of her son was allowed to leave jail Saturday to grieve her 1-year old son.

news.summary: The officer tried to stop the car to assess the situation because the driving mimicked someone who may be impaired or experiencing a medical emergency.

news.title: 19-year-old arrested for fatal shooting that killed 13-year-old in Atlanta
news.summary: Investigators arrested Davion Curney on Friday for his involvement in the homicide.

news.summary: Two people were shot Saturday morning on Roswell Rd in Sandy Springs, as police investigate the circumstances surrounding the incident.

news.summary: A 33-year-old man was found with a gunshot wound. Medical personnel pronounced him deceased.

news.title: Police search for woman, minors in Stockbridge Walmart shoplifting case
news.summary: Authorities are asking for the public's help to identify a woman wanted in connection with an attempted shoplifting incident at a Walmart in Stockbridge.

news.title: Neighbor fires 50 shots at Gwinnett County home near Norris Lake

news.title: 33-year-old man killed in shooting near southwest Atlanta apartment

news.title: Stolen dog recovered: Austell police arrest 2 after gas station theft
news.summary: A dog stolen from a gas station parking lot Thursday night is back home safe after Austell police tracked down the suspect vehicle and arrested two people.

news.title: Former rideshare driver sentenced to 25 years for child trafficking
